newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain sees good relations with new French cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Spain sees good relations with new French cabinet.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Monday he expected to have the same degree of cooperation with the new French government on Europe's single currency as with the previous.

"I am sure we can work with the new French government as we did with the previous one, in the definition of a policy of European integration that gives macroeconomic stability to Europe and also gives us a strong and stable currency," he told journalists on the fringes of a business seminar.
Rato said the news did not effect domestic or foreign confidence in the Spanish economy.
The Socialist win seems likely to point to a broader, less strict monetary union that should ensure Spain a place in its first wave.
But many experts already expected Spain to reach the launch, and financial markets were initially upset amid fears the vote it might upset the entire project.
